purpose: Measured Labelary Font 0 shapes at Unicode codepoints. These aliases select open-source donor outlines; they do not alter input text or claim Unicode glyph equivalence in other fonts.

U+00B5.evidence: Candidate mathematical italic mu for the slanted Labelary micro-sign. This is a donor choice to be scored, not an asserted exact match.

U+0027.evidence: Identical isolated Labelary glyph rasters at h47/w47: apostrophe and right single quotation mark.

U+002D.evidence: Identical isolated Labelary glyph rasters at h47/w47: hyphen-minus and en dash.

U+005C.evidence: font0-semantics-ci28-backslash-cent-h70-w100.zpl: literal and UTF-8 hex spellings all have 1235 ink pixels and zero pairwise differences.

U+0060.evidence: Identical isolated Labelary glyph rasters at h47/w47: grave accent and left single quotation mark.

U+007E.evidence: Identical isolated Labelary glyph rasters at h47/w47: tilde and small tilde.

U+2015.evidence: Identical isolated Labelary glyph rasters at h47/w47: horizontal bar and minus sign.
